entries.origin_analysis: Impact Atlas Phase 1 found a broad higher-timeframe market-state surface requiring a dedicated routing study. Market-State Routing Phase 2 selected the portable H4-alignment equivalence class across 2023H1, 2023H2, 2024H1 and 2024H2. Core then proved exact H4-state and permission parity, controlled order-path integration, account-currency reconciliation and bounded native full-equity DD improvement.
entries.causal_hypothesis: B02 and F05 entries taken against the latest completed exact-slot H4 EMA(6,24) directional state have lower expected value than aligned entries, so blocking opposed or neutral entries should improve portfolio net, PF and equity DD without strategy-specific repair.
target_failure_mode: B02/F05 entries against higher-timeframe directional state
portfolio equity drawdown caused by retained opposed entries

entries.decision: All pre-2025 gates pass. Authorize one unchanged candidate-specific 2025H1 Rakuten MT4 binding exposure only after the outcome-free protocol is merged and the reusable workflow preflight passes. Keep 2025H2 locked.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: The unbounded $615.74 versus $687.48 equity-DD comparison represented 2023-2024 risk; it inherited a single 2021 running peak and was superseded by bounded in-window authority.
retained_findings: Research counterfactual net improvement is positive in all four half-year folds.
Exact H4 state and row-level permission parity are zero mismatch.
Native account net and PF improve after accounting-currency repair.
Bounded full-equity DD improves by $110.17 or 35.33%, with candidate non-worse in all four half-year folds.
The candidate is a shared B02/F05 admission router, not a repair of Entry, Exit, SL or TP.
